faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Central Bank of India Office Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Office Assistant post is 05 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 22 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years for the Office Assistant position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Office Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates (BSW/BA/B.Com) with computer knowledge. Basic accounting knowledge, proficiency in MS Office, Tally, and internet skills are also required.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the Central Bank of India Office Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Office Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 20000 per month, along with applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Office Assistant post will be based on a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Central Bank of India Office Assistant recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. Which language skills are essential for the Office Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must be fluent in the local language. Typing skills in the local language are essential, and fluency in Hindi/English is an added advantage.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates need to be attached with the application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the Central Bank of India's official website, links for which are provided in the Important Links section.
